nodes.title: Place shapes in the work area on click
nodes.summary: Clicking a shape button places that shape in the work area.

nodes.title: Add a centre point and always centre the shape
nodes.summary: Show a centre point in the work area, and always keep the placed shape centred on it.

nodes.title: Create a default-named component for each added shape
nodes.summary: Adding a new shape by default creates a component with a default name, with the shape added to the canvas area as part of that component.

nodes.title: Show components in a file-explorer style hierarchy panel
nodes.summary: A hierarchy panel on the right of the page lists each component's name in a file-explorer style tree. Nested under each component as a child is a reference to the shape just added to the canvas area.
